video_title: Kevin Durant IS NOT Top 10 All-Time??? Tim Hardaway Sr Lists His Top 10 Players in History

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr's assessment of Steph Curry's all-time ranking
quotes.excerpt: if Steph wasn't hurt a couple of times for a long period of time, he'd be top five
quotes.quote: Top 10, top 15, right there of course. You know, the longevity, what they've been doing, how they've been doing it. I'm going to tell you this, if Steph wasn't hurt a couple of times for a long period of time, he'd be top five.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's impact on the Raptors championship series
quotes.excerpt: if he didn't hurt his Achilles or his calf, they would have won a championship against Toronto
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant, you know, I say this, if he didn't hurt his Achilles or his calf, they would have won a championship against Toronto. Toronto didn't have enough for them. They had too much firepower and when Durant went down, they knew that they could win because Durant was the key to winning that championship.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Defending Kevin Durant's shot selection and playstyle
quotes.excerpt: People be like, you took five shots or you took ten shots. Well, that's what the game dictated
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant, I love how he plays. And you know he plays the right way. People be like, you took five shots or you took ten shots. Well, that's what the game dictated. What you want me to force things? And everybody knew that VanVleet, when he came back, he was going to be running the show.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Marcus Smart on the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: bringing Smart to the team, oh man, I love that
quotes.quote: Bringing Smart to the team, oh man, I love that. I love that because he is a natural point guard and he can play point guard. He can play two, three, and four if you want him to. But he can play point guard and run the show and make shots too. He has made big shots before.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' potential with a healthy roster
quotes.excerpt: they going to be a tough out in Houston if they stay healthy
quotes.quote: They waited, waited, waited to VanVleet came back healthy and got Marcus Smart. They going to be a tough out in Houston if they stay healthy.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: The increase in on-court fighting in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: is it just me, but is it a lot of people ready to fight?
quotes.quote: Is it just me, but is it a lot of people ready to fight? I mean, what's up with that? People are ready to fight.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's exclusion from the top 10 all-time list
quotes.excerpt: I think KD won't be a top 10. I think he'll be 11, 12, in the 15, maybe 20
quotes.quote: I think KD won't be a top 10. I think he'll be 11, 12, in the 15, maybe 20, but he's right there.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard's status as a top five defensive guard
quotes.excerpt: Luke Kennard right now to me is top five in the NBA
quotes.quote: What you think about Luke Kennard? You know, Luke Kennard right now to me is top five in the NBA. No question about that. One of the best defensive guards in the NBA and shows it each and every night.
